title.original: Contextual Agent Security: A Policy for Every Purpose
title.zh: 情境化智能体安全：面向不同用途的策略
title.en: Contextual Agent Security: A Policy for Every Purpose

inclusion_reason.zh: Conseca 的上下文采集、即时策略生成、人可读表示和动作门构成可嵌入通用 Agent 的权限控制框架。
inclusion_reason.en: Conseca's context collection, just-in-time policy generation, human-readable representation, and action gate form an embeddable permission-control framework.

abstract.zh: Conseca 提出上下文 Agent 安全框架，为每个具体目标、内容和账户情境即时生成可由人理解并确认的动作策略。
abstract.en: Conseca proposes contextual agent security: generating just-in-time, human-verifiable action policies from the concrete goal, content, account, and operating context.

problem.zh: 通用 Agent 的任务和能力组合远超静态 App 权限或 ACL 的枚举范围，同一动作在不同目标、数据和身份上下文中安全性相反。
problem.en: Generalist agents exceed what static app permissions or ACLs can enumerate, and the same action can be safe or unsafe depending on goals, data, and identity context.

approach.zh: 框架在动作执行前提取当前目的与环境属性，生成针对该次行动的细粒度策略，并把关键约束呈现给用户核验。
approach.en: Before execution, the framework extracts purpose and environment attributes, generates an action-specific policy, and presents key constraints for user verification.

system_design.zh: 概念架构由上下文收集器、策略生成器、人可读策略表示、确认界面和动作执行门组成，策略随任务即时产生。
system_design.en: The conceptual architecture combines context collection, policy generation, a human-readable representation, confirmation, and an action gate, producing policies per task.

key_results.zh: 论文确立了从“固定权限”转向“目的与上下文绑定策略”的设计方向，并以邮件删除等案例说明静态授权的不足。
key_results.en: The paper establishes a shift from fixed permissions to purpose- and context-bound policies, using cases such as email deletion to expose static authorization limits.

limitations.zh: 该工作主要是框架探索，未证明上下文抽取和策略生成在对抗输入下可靠；频繁人工确认也可能引发疲劳。
limitations.en: This is primarily a framework exploration; reliable context extraction and policy generation under attack are not demonstrated, and frequent confirmation may cause fatigue.

notes.zh: 实验矩阵与数值将在全文人工复核后补充；当前留空以避免从摘要推断。
notes.en: The experiment matrix and numbers await full-text manual review; fields remain empty to avoid inferring them from an abstract.
